CorticalFlow can learn a diffeomorphic transformation from a reference template to a target object with only one hundred training examples, and can be applied to a new object with a single forward pass through the network.
CorticalFlow can be used to generate surfaces with hundreds of thousands of vertices in real-time on a GPU.
